meaning: Find the best threshold-qualified occurrence of a stored image template in the current visual evidence.
current_runtime_value: RuntimeTemplateMatch? is converted to LiveExecutionOutcome text; null is shown as not found.
absent_semantics: The template search completed successfully but no candidate in the requested region reached the threshold before timeout.
negative_result_semantics: No separate negative scalar exists; a score, including 0 when threshold permits it, is data inside ImageMatch.
failure_semantics: Vision adapter unavailable, template resource missing or unreadable, capture unavailable, or comparison failed.
first_loss_point: compareScreenshotRegions returns nullable score, so missing evidence, comparison failure and no match collapse before RuntimeTemplateMatch; LiveExecutionOutcome then discards region and score.
current_transport_path: WorkspaceScreen vision callback -> RuntimeTemplateMatch? -> WorkspaceBasicRuntime statement outcome text.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Keep stable ID action.findTemplate and import aliases findTemplate/FIND_TEMPLATE; canonical templateFind normalization must preserve all five arguments.

meaning: Return the best textual observation matching the requested text from one completed perception pass.
current_runtime_value: No value-returning provider or runtime handler exists; the catalog currently produces only a statement trace.
absent_semantics: OCR/perception completed successfully and produced no text observation matching the query.
negative_result_semantics: No negative scalar; confidence 0 is a legitimate TextMatch field only when a provider emits such a match.
failure_semantics: Vision adapter unavailable, screen capture failed, OCR engine failed, or provider response was malformed.
first_loss_point: There is no provider result contract or WorkspaceBasicRuntime environment function.
current_transport_path: Catalog statement -> generic trace only; no producer-to-runtime value path.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Keep stable ID vision.findText and aliases Region.findText/FIND_TEXT. Singular findText returns the best match; a future multi-match command must use a distinct ID.

meaning: Load an immutable snapshot of a persisted marker resource by stable marker ID or legacy label.
current_runtime_value: RuntimeAutomationRegion? is returned by the callback after mutating canvas selection; marker identity and metadata are discarded.
absent_semantics: The marker repository was read successfully and contains no marker with the requested ID or label.
negative_result_semantics: No negative scalar and no empty-marker sentinel.
failure_semantics: Marker repository unavailable, persisted marker malformed, or geometry/metadata decoding failed.
first_loss_point: WorkspaceScreen markerLoad projects ScreenshotCanvasSavedMarker to region only and uses null for both missing and failed storage paths.
current_transport_path: Persisted marker list -> ScreenshotCanvasSavedMarker -> RuntimeAutomationRegion? -> statement outcome text.
required_new_value_type: MarkerValue(markerId, label, region, path, mode, assetId, threshold)
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Keep markerLoad/Marker.load/LOAD_MARKER. Lookup may accept a legacy label, but the returned value must retain the stable marker ID and must not be a live UI handle.

meaning: Report Tasker's own enabled preference, not complete WSS-to-Tasker execution readiness.
current_runtime_value: TaskerRegistrationStatus.available combines installation, RUN_TASKS permission, enabled preference, external access and receiver availability.
negative_result_semantics: false means Tasker is not installed or its own enabled preference is explicitly false.
failure_semantics: Adapter unavailable, installation inspection failed, or the installed Tasker preference could not be read reliably.
first_loss_point: taskerPrefSet converts provider exceptions and missing rows to null; WorkspaceScreen then substitutes composite status.available.
current_transport_path: Tasker content-provider/package inspection -> TaskerRegistrationStatus -> RuntimeAdapterResult success/message without typed value.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Tasker.isEnabled to tasker.isEnabled while retaining the former spelling as an import alias.

meaning: Read the current String value of one named Tasker variable.
current_runtime_value: No Runner/Receiver result contract is connected and no value is produced.
absent_semantics: The Tasker query succeeded but the named variable does not exist.
negative_result_semantics: An empty String is a legitimate variable value and must not become ABSENT.
failure_semantics: Tasker or adapter unavailable, permission/access denied, IPC failed, or response was malformed.
first_loss_point: The Tasker adapter has no value-returning receiver/session path for getVariable.
current_transport_path: Catalog statement -> unconnected Tasker adapter warning; no return payload.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Tasker.getVariable to tasker.getVariable and retain the legacy alias and variable-reference argument spelling.

meaning: Return all Tasker variable name/value pairs matching the optional pattern.
current_runtime_value: No collection result producer or receiver contract exists.
absent_semantics: No ABSENT state; a successful query always returns a list.
negative_result_semantics: An empty list means the query succeeded and no variables matched. Empty String remains a legitimate TaskerVariable value.
failure_semantics: Tasker or adapter unavailable, permission/access denied, IPC failed, or collection response was malformed.
first_loss_point: The Tasker bridge has no collection-returning receiver/session path or runtime list value.
current_transport_path: Catalog statement -> unconnected Tasker adapter warning; no collection payload.
existing_emscript_value: ContractValue.ListValue exists only in language-core; runtime EmscriptValue has no list or TaskerVariable value.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Tasker.getVariables to tasker.getVariables and retain the legacy spelling; result ordering must be deterministic by variable name.

meaning: Return the UID of the currently available Shizuku service.
current_runtime_value: ShizukuRegistrationStatus.uid is rendered as -1 when unavailable; inspectAvailability also suppresses getUid exceptions into null.
absent_semantics: No Shizuku service UID is currently available because Shizuku is not installed, permission is not granted, or the binder is not alive.
negative_result_semantics: 0 is a legitimate UID and must remain NumberValue(0); negative sentinel values are forbidden.
failure_semantics: Adapter unavailable, package/permission/binder inspection failed technically, getUid threw, or returned an invalid negative UID.
first_loss_point: inspectShizukuAvailability uses runCatching(uidProbe).getOrNull and WorkspaceScreen converts null to -1 text.
current_transport_path: Shizuku inspection -> nullable Int -> RuntimeAdapterResult message text with -1 sentinel.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Shizuku.getUid to shizuku.getUid and retain the legacy spelling; remove only the -1 sentinel, not valid UID 0.

meaning: Read one supported Termux registration-status property as canonical text.
current_runtime_value: Known keys produce String text; an unknown key becomes empty String and all inspection faults are flattened into status fields.
absent_semantics: The requested key is not in the frozen key set: installed, apiInstalled, canRunCommands, permission, summary.
negative_result_semantics: Supported Boolean/status keys return explicit text such as false or missing; these are values, not ABSENT. Empty String is not a missing-key sentinel in V1.
failure_semantics: Adapter unavailable or package/permission/status inspection failed technically.
first_loss_point: TermuxRegistration.inspect uses Boolean fallbacks, then WorkspaceScreen maps unknown keys to empty String and stores the value only in message text.
current_transport_path: Termux registration inspection -> key switch -> RuntimeAdapterResult message text.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Termux.get to termux.get and retain the legacy spelling. Empty key remains a legacy alias for summary; unknown nonempty keys become NullValue.

meaning: Report whether a scrcpy session for the optional serial is actively running.
current_runtime_value: Vt2VtUsbAdbBridgeStatus.bridgeReady is substituted for scrcpy process/session state.
negative_result_semantics: false means the session registry was inspected successfully and no matching scrcpy session is running, including when no host/device is available.
failure_semantics: scrcpy adapter unavailable or session/process state could not be inspected reliably.
first_loss_point: WorkspaceScreen uses USB/ADB bridge readiness instead of a scrcpy session registry; Vt2VtUsbAdbBridge.detect also converts technical probe errors to false.
current_transport_path: VT2VT USB/ADB status -> bridgeReady Boolean -> RuntimeAdapterResult success/message without typed value.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Scrcpy.isRunning to scrcpy.isRunning and retain the legacy spelling. Optional serial selects one session without changing return type.

meaning: Read one textual property of the active scrcpy session selected by the provider and key.
current_runtime_value: The requested key is ignored and the VT2VT USB/ADB bridge summary is always embedded in message text.
absent_semantics: A known session key has no value because no matching active session exists. Frozen keys are sessionId, serial, state, transport, host and port.
negative_result_semantics: No negative scalar; textual state values such as stopped are legitimate values when supplied by an existing session snapshot.
failure_semantics: Adapter unavailable, session inspection failed, response malformed, or a nonempty key is outside the frozen key set.
first_loss_point: WorkspaceScreen ignores key semantics and substitutes Vt2VtUsbAdbBridgeStatus.summary for a scrcpy session value.
current_transport_path: VT2VT USB/ADB status -> summary String -> RuntimeAdapterResult message text.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Scrcpy.get to scrcpy.get and retain the legacy spelling; key names are case-insensitive on import and canonical lowerCamelCase on serialization.

meaning: Test whether the chart repository contains a chart snapshot with the requested stable ID.
current_runtime_value: No chart dispatch, repository lookup or result exists in WorkspaceBasicRuntime.
negative_result_semantics: false means the chart repository was read successfully and contains no chart with that ID.
failure_semantics: Chart adapter/repository unavailable or repository lookup failed.
first_loss_point: No provider-independent chart repository adapter is connected to WorkspaceBasicRuntime.
current_transport_path: Catalog statement only; ChartGraph domain models are not connected to EMScript runtime.
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Chart.exists to chart.exists and retain the legacy spelling; chart ID is a persistent resource ID, not a runtime handle.

meaning: Load an immutable chart value snapshot by persistent chart ID.
current_runtime_value: No chart dispatch or value exists; the optional legacy key has no repository-backed semantics.
absent_semantics: The chart repository was read successfully and contains no chart with the requested ID.
negative_result_semantics: An existing chart with empty series/data is a legitimate ChartSnapshot value, not ABSENT.
failure_semantics: Chart adapter/repository unavailable, persisted chart malformed, or snapshot decoding failed.
first_loss_point: No chart repository adapter or EMScript chart value exists; catalog metadata is the only current path.
current_transport_path: Catalog statement only; ChartDocument exists in the plugin but is not transported into EMScript.
existing_emscript_value: NullValue only; ChartDocument is a plugin domain model, not an EMScript runtime value.
required_new_value_type: ChartSnapshotValue(id, title, kind, immutable data and options)
roundtrip_legacy_risk: Normalize Chart.get to chart.get and retain the legacy spelling. Canonical V1 uses chart.get(id); the optional legacy key is import-only and must fail explicitly until mapped to a dedicated property command.
